open1.text: This is a simulated benchmark: two alloy discovery campaigns, replayed for a whole year in a digital twin of our planned automated lab.
open1.spoken: This is a simulated benchmark: two alloy discovery campaigns, replayed for a whole year in a digital twin of our planned automated lab.

open2.text: Some of it comes from real sources: the lab's design and its 3-D model, footage from our own atomizer, the search spaces in the two proposals, and published prices. Everything else is simulated: every alloy, every measurement, and every result.
open2.spoken: Some of it comes from real sources: the lab's design and its three D model, footage from our own atomizer, the search spaces in the two proposals, and published prices. Everything else is simulated: every alloy, every measurement, and every result.

dag1.text: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. BOFN, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.
dag1.spoken: Each campaign is a function network: a chain of steps, where each step's results feed the next. B O F N, Bayesian optimization over function networks, models every step, not just the final score.
dag1.phonemes: ˈiːtʃ kæmpˈeɪn ɪz ɐ fˈʌŋkʃən nˈɛtwɜːk: ɐ tʃˈeɪn ʌv stˈɛps, wˌɛɹ ˈiːtʃ stˈɛps ɹɪzˈʌlts fˈiːd ðə nˈɛkst. bˈiː ˈoʊ ˈɛf ˈɛn, beɪˈiːʒən ˌɑːptɪmᵻzˈeɪʃən ˌoʊvɚ fˈʌŋkʃən nˈɛtwɜːks, mˈɑːdəlz ˈɛvɹi stˈɛp, nˌɑːt dʒˈʌst ðə fˈaɪnəl skˈɔːɹ.

dag2.text: For aluminium, the lab makes each alloy's powder itself, then prints it and checks every build.
dag2.spoken: For aluminum, the lab makes each alloy's powder itself, then prints it and checks every build.

dag3.text: For copper, a one-hour corrosion screen ranks the DED deposits, and thirty days in seawater come before a utility is known.
dag3.spoken: For copper, a one-hour corrosion screen ranks the D E D deposits, and thirty days in seawater come before a utility is known.
dag3.phonemes: fɔːɹ kˈɑːpɚ, ɐ wˈʌnˈaʊɚ kɚɹˈoʊʒən skɹˈiːn ɹˈæŋks ðə dˈiː ˈiː dˈiː dᵻpˈɑːzɪts, ænd θˈɜːɾi dˈeɪz ɪn sˈiːwɔːɾɚ kˈʌm bᵻfˌɔːɹ ɐ juːtˈɪlᵻɾi ɪz nˈoʊn.

dag4.text: Both campaigns share one lab. From here on, each step is an icon that lights up while it runs.
dag4.spoken: Both campaigns share one lab. From here on, each step is an icon that lights up while it runs.

fig2.text: Against money, the same curve shows what the progress cost. The grey dashed curve is the conventional lab, running the same optimizer through partner and core facilities.
fig2.spoken: Against money, the same curve shows what the progress cost. The grey dashed curve is the conventional lab, running the same optimizer through partner and core facilities.
fig2.phonemes: ɐɡˈɛnst mˈʌni, ðə sˈeɪm kˈɜːv ʃˈoʊz wʌt ðə pɹˈɑːɡɹɛs kˈɔst. ðə ɡɹˈeɪ dˈæʃt kˈɜːv ɪz ðə kənvˈɛnʃənəl lˈæb, ɹˈʌnɪŋ ðə sˈeɪm ˈɑːptɪmˌaɪzɚ θɹuː pˈɑːɹtnɚ ænd kˈɔːɹ fəsˈɪlᵻɾiz.

fig3.text: Where each first reaches the target, the median over the runs, gives the acceleration factor: here 220 days over 116, or 1.9 times. Money gives the cost ratio the same way.

pov1.text: Day one follows a single simulated aluminium alloy from start to finish. Its cup is machined, its metals are dosed and pressed under vacuum, then melted and atomized into powder.
pov1.spoken: Day one follows a single simulated aluminum alloy from start to finish. Its cup is machined, its metals are dosed and pressed under vacuum, then melted and atomized into powder.

pov4.spoken: Wire E D M cuts its bars, and a tensile test scores it, about a day and a half after its cup was machined.

res1.text: In the automated lab, over twelve simulated years, BOFN finished highest on aluminium. On copper, tiered CALPHAD screening finished ahead, even of BOFN with blend screening: 0.69 against 0.67.
res1.spoken: In the automated lab, over twelve simulated years, B O F N finished highest on aluminum. On copper, tiered CALPHAD screening finished ahead, even of B O F N with blend screening: 0.69 against 0.67.
res1.phonemes: ɪnðɪ ˈɔːɾəmˌeɪɾᵻd lˈæb, ˌoʊvɚ twˈɛlv sˈɪmjʊlˌeɪɾᵻd jˈɪɹz, bˈiː ˈoʊ ˈɛf ˈɛn fˈɪnɪʃt hˈaɪɪst ˌɔn ɐlˈuːmɪnəm. ˌɔn kˈɑːpɚ, tˈɪɹd kˈælfæd skɹˈiːnɪŋ fˈɪnɪʃt ɐhˈɛd, ˈiːvən ʌv bˈiː ˈoʊ ˈɛf ˈɛn wɪð blˈɛnd skɹˈiːnɪŋ: zˈiəɹoʊ pɔɪnt sˈɪks nˈaɪn ɐɡˈɛnst zˈiəɹoʊ pɔɪnt sˈɪks sˈɛvən.

res2.text: Against the conventional lab running the same BOFN, the automated lab reached the state of the art 1.9 times sooner on aluminium, and 3.7 times sooner on copper, where the conventional lab got there in only half its runs.

res3.text: Per demonstrated alloy, the automated lab costs more while the two campaigns carry its equipment alone. Shared with outside users at sixty percent use, it costs less than the conventional lab.
